headlines.title: Anthropic IPO filing will show AI backlash as a risk factor, sources say
headlines.summary: Anthropic is poised to debut on the stock market at a time when the public is increasingly upset about data centers and is fearful about AI taking jobs.

headlines.summary: Trump had already postponed the 50% tariffs on a range of Canadian goods so Washington and Ottawa could finalize a tentative deal.

headlines.summary: Apple has admitted that some roles are being impacted as it shifts its focus away from certain initiatives.

headlines.title: Supreme Court allows Trump to continue White House ballroom construction for now
headlines.summary: President Donald Trump had the White House's East Wing demolished in 2025 to make way for his controversial planned ballroom.

headlines.title: Tesla’s stock jumps as the company gets cleared for a Las Vegas robotaxi launch
headlines.summary: The automaker plans to soon launch its Cybercab in Austin, Texas, and got the nod to deploy thousands of vehicles in Nevada.

headlines.title: TikTok reaches $400M settlement over children’s privacy lawsuit
headlines.summary: Two years after the U.S. Department of Justice alleged that TikTok violated the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act, it has reached a $400 million settlement.

headlines.summary: Billionaire investor Ray Dalio said the the debt buyback announcement this week fits into a larger pattern that could signal a forthcoming debt crisis.

headlines.summary: Amid changes to student visa policies, colleges and universities are likely to see fewer international students enrolled this fall, reports show.

economy.summary: Fed Funds Rate 3.63，近 3 期趨勢 持平；美國 10 年期公債殖利率 4.738，近 3 期趨勢 連續上升；VIX 15.13，近 3 期趨勢 最近一期下降。整體總經風險分級：medium。

strategies.price_above_ma200: 收盤價高於 200 日均線時持有，否則空手。
strategies.ma20_cross_ma60: 20 日均線高於 60 日均線時持有，否則空手。
strategies.buy_and_hold: 買入持有基準，用於比較策略是否優於單純持有。

assumptions.transaction_cost_note: 每次部位變化扣除 0.1% 交易成本，用於保守估計。
assumptions.lookahead_bias_control: 策略使用前一交易日訊號承擔下一交易日報酬，避免偷看未來資料。

signals.disclaimer: 研究訊號僅供分析，不是買賣建議。
